translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: A jun b'it tic sb'itaj yuj vin̈ cuchb'um d'a b'it, yic snaancot Dios tastac tzon̈ ic'ani. Sb'it jun tic vin̈aj David.

content.text: Mamin Jehová, man̈ ac' in yaelal yuj yoval a c'ool. Man̈ ac' in yaelal yacb'an aycot a c'ac'alc'olal.
Toxo ix och tzolan a jul-lab' d'ayin, ix ac'och in yaelal.
A yuj yoval a c'ool chi', masanil in nivanil tic te ya' ay svab'i, yujn̈ej to ix och in mul d'ayach.
A in chucal ichato c'ojanq'ue d'a vib'an̈ icha icatz, maxtzac techajlaj vuuj.
Yujn̈ej in pital, vanxo sq'ue sjab' vechen yujto van sc'ab'ati.
N̈ojan in emi tzin b'eyi. Juneln̈ej lachan vaji. Maxtzac och vaan jab'oc in cusc'olal.
Van in cham yuj q'uixvelal svab'i. Masanil in nivanil te ya ay svab'i.
Ix te b'uychaj in nivanil tic, man̈xalaj jab'oc yip. Tzin c'acvi yuj vilc'olal.
Mamin Vajalil, ojtac masanil tas tzin nib'ej. Ayic sic'son sja in c'ool, ichan̈ yaj jun tic.
Toxon̈ej ste tin̈tin̈an in pixan yab'an syail. Numumi yel vip, maxtzac yal-laj vilani.
A eb' anima vach' vac'an yed'oc yed' eb' junn̈ej tzin ec' yed'oc, najat sb'esel sb'a eb' d'ayin. A eb' cajan d'a in lac'anil, najat sb'esel sb'a eb' d'ayin yuj in yaelal.
A eb' sgana in smilanchamoc, van yac'anem in yaalil eb'. A eb' snib'an yac' chucal d'ayin, an̈ej chucal syal eb' d'a in patic. Max ochlaj vaan eb' snaub'tan̈an tas ol in yutoc d'a elc'altac.
A inxo pax jun, ichato macan in chiquin, max vab'laj tas syal eb', ichato max ujilaj in loloni, malaj tas tz'elta d'a in ti'.
Lajan in icha junoc mach max yab'laj, max yal-laj yalan sb'a.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal, a achn̈ej tzach vac'och yipoc in c'ool, a ach ol in a tac'vej.
A jun tic tzin c'an d'ayach: Mocab' in stzetzej eb' ajc'ol chi'. Mocab' b'itan eb' yuj tzalajc'olal tato tzin ac'ji ganar.
Palta ijanxo val tzin ac'ji ganar svab'i. Max och vaan jab'oc in yaelal tic.
Ol valq'ueta in mul. Man̈xo in animaoc svab' yuj in chucal.
A eb' ajc'ol sgana in chami, toxo ix te q'uib' sb'isul eb'. Man̈xo jantacoc ix te aj eb' tzin chacani, vach'chom malaj in mul d'a eb'.
Chucn̈ej syutej sb'a eb' d'ayin yuj in vach'c'olal d'a eb'. Yujn̈ej to tzin b'eyb'alej vach'il, tz'och eb' ajc'olal d'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, man̈ in actejcani. Ach in Diosal, man̈ a b'esel a b'a d'ayin.
Ach Vajalil, ach in Columal, cotan̈ d'a elan̈chamel tzin a colani.
